title: The 20-minute annual SIP review
objectives: Run the ten-point annual SIP review.
Name the life events that call for an extra review.
body_md:
Review every SIP once a year, plus after any major life event. One 20-minute review does more than ten panicked calls.

## The ten checks

- Goal still right? Update the target for inflation and any change in plans.
- On track? Compare the projected value with the target using XIRR, not absolute return.
- Step-up? Raise the SIP by 5–10% if income has grown.
- Funds: compare each with its benchmark and category over 3–5 years, not one bad year.
- Mix: rebalance if it has drifted by more than 5–10 percentage points.
- End dates: note SIPs ending in the next 12 months and plan renewals.
- Glide path: any goal now within 3 years? Start the shift to debt.
- Too many SIPs? Overlapping funds add complexity, not diversification.
- Admin: mandate validity, bank account, nominee and KYC.
- Record: note what was decided and why, and share it with the client.

## Life events that trigger an extra review

A job change or raise, marriage, a child's birth, a new loan, an inheritance or bonus, a health expense, a move abroad, and retirement.
example: A review in April finds a goal that is now 2 years away, a SIP ending in June, and a mix that has drifted 8 points. The client renews, starts the glide path, and moves the step-up money into debt rather than equity.
say: Let's do the twenty-minute review: goal, progress by XIRR, step-up, funds, mix and admin.
This SIP ends in June, so let's decide the renewal today.
never: Your SIP is running, so the review is done.
Let's skip the mix; the funds are doing well.

check.q: How should progress towards a goal be measured in the annual review?
check.why: XIRR handles SIP cash flows correctly; absolute return hides the effect of timing.

check.q: When should a SIP be reviewed?
o: Once a year, plus after any major life event
check.why: Every SIP gets an annual review, and an extra one after a job change, marriage, a child, a loan, a bonus or retirement.

check.q: A SIP ends in nine months. What should the review do?
o: Ignore it; the AMC will call
Note it and plan the renewal now
check.why: Note SIPs ending in the next 12 months and plan renewals; the call goes three months before the end date.
